published_implementation.historical_relation: The pinned first-party STALE-bench repository contains the validated benchmark instances, benchmark implementation, corrected grading harness, committed agent-study outputs and raw result artifacts. The measured parallel-work and communication organization is benchmark-defined rather than a native canonical harness boundary.

study_surfaces.reported_finding: The first-party README reports interference approximately tracking planted staleness and a precise message recovering 98% of the synthetic interference cases.

observations.grading_correction_note: The repository explicitly retains an earlier naive real-tier result only to document a measurement artifact. The corrected harness discards agent test edits and grades every condition on the union test set; capability claims in this observation use the corrected and explicitly labeled synthetic/real-derived surfaces, not the uncorrected real_delta_blind, OpenHands, naive communication, or read/write outputs.
observations.result_summary: STALE publishes strong semantic-interference attenuation in controlled synthetic and real-derived parallel-coding tiers while its corrected mined-real Django control shows essentially no observable interference. The contrast is preserved rather than collapsed into one headline interference rate.
observations.provenance_limitation: The repository ships the raw stochastic agent outputs and deterministic benchmark core, but this corpus has not independently rerun the model-backed experiments. The strong communication-recovery findings belong to benchmark-defined synthetic and real-derived conditions; the corrected mined-real corpus is a negative control and must not be represented as supporting the same high interference rate.
